grammars.name: 数学概念形变
grammars.summary: 黑底上一个对象平滑变成另一个，颜色对应概念。
grammars.prompt: Create an approximately 10-second web animation from this script: {script}. Deliver one self-contained HTML file with embedded CSS and JavaScript using the 3Blue1Brown Mathematical Visualization animation grammar. Show one mathematical or conceptual object on pure black #000000; define exactly what becomes what before staging the sequence. Use Computer Modern-style serif mathematics and compatible Chinese serif text, thin clean lines and at most four stable semantic colors from blue #58C4DD, red #FC6255, yellow #FFFF00, teal #5CD0B3 and green #83C167, with gray support lines; the source boosts saturation by 1.5. Symbols and corresponding objects must share colors throughout. Begin with the object, not a title; keep no more than two textual points visible. Morph resampled, start-aligned shapes point by point using smooth quintic easing 6t^5-15t^4+10t^3, normally allowing 1–3 seconds per meaningful change and a readable stationary pause. Use linear stroke writing, slight stagger, purposeful signal flashes, matching-symbol replacements or an identified-object zoom-through rather than arbitrary cuts. Highlight the target before entering it, preserve continuity across transformations and hold the final conclusion. The camera moves only to inspect a new object and then stops. Do not add bloom, navy gradient backgrounds, decorative floating/breathing, endless slow zoom, bullet-list slides, inconsistent color meanings or mathematically incorrect connections; choose a small enough chain for ten seconds.

grammars.name: 发布会产品演示
grammars.summary: 产品画面占主位，文字和数字跟着讲解逐个落定。
grammars.prompt: Create an approximately 10-second web animation from this script: {script}. Deliver one self-contained HTML file with embedded CSS and JavaScript using the Keynote UI Motion animation grammar. Make the product itself the focal subject, with one noun, feature or number per screen. Use supplied product screenshots or product visuals at least 80% of landscape width or 90% of portrait width, zooming to the relevant detail; embed any supplied assets in the HTML. Follow the product's own brand colors instead of default purple-blue gradients. The source's optional presentation palette is near-black #050508/#08090a with primary white #f5f5f7 and secondary #a7a7b4; use Inter-like sans serif, 600-weight tight-tracked headings, fine rounded icons and restrained rounded geometry. Select at most two optional treatments among gradient light blobs, frosted glass, gradient lettering, centered blur reveals and floating decoration; settled cards themselves must stay still. Use critically damped or barely bouncing springs, 0.28-second purposeful pushes of 18–32%, 0.30-second same-scale pans and short number impacts. Time counters to finish when the narration says the value, count each number once and use tabular digits. Prefer shared-element expansion, match cuts or blur transitions with covered edges; new content inside an expanding card must be opaque immediately. Avoid tiny cards on empty backgrounds, repeating title/three-cards/number layouts, decorative idle drift, excessive spring bounce or using celebratory launch styling for serious bad news.

grammars.name: 财经图表动画
grammars.summary: 坐标系先出现，数据逐项长出，再标记一个重点。
grammars.prompt: Create an approximately 10-second web animation from this script: {script}. Deliver one self-contained HTML file with embedded CSS and JavaScript using the Finance Chart Animation animation grammar. Stage each chart as axes first, data second and one conclusion annotation last. Use only supplied values, units and sources; if illustrative data is explicitly used, label it as such on every view. Keep ratios reproducible, distinguish growth-to from growth-by, start bars at zero and label any truncated non-bar axis. Use white #FFFFFF, salmon #FFF1E5 or a dark #0E1116 background matching the film; a red #E3120B rule, blue #006BA2 or cyan #3EBCD2 main series, gray #C6D2D8 secondary data and restrained horizontal gridlines. Use clear sans-serif labels and tabular numbers, with metric/unit subtitle and visible source. Grow bars from their baseline with staggered quintic-out easing, reveal lines by x/time rather than path length, synchronize labels and reveal event annotations only as the trace reaches them. Candles grow from open to close before wicks appear. State the market's up/down color convention or use blue/orange with direction symbols. Settle values on their spoken cue and hold at least 0.5 seconds; camera pushes are brief purposeful events followed by stillness. Never invent factual figures, distort magnitude through animation, morph between different measures, continuously drift over settled charts or repeat the same layout more than three times.

grammars.name: 扁平科普
grammars.summary: 抽象概念化成具体物体，镜头在不同尺度间穿行。
grammars.prompt: Create an approximately 10-second web animation from this script: {script}. Deliver one self-contained HTML file with embedded CSS and JavaScript using the Kurzgesagt Flat Explainer animation grammar. Turn each abstract idea into a concrete visual metaphor and move between meaningful scales. Use flat unoutlined organic geometry with same-hue shadow planes, small highlight edges and restrained radial glow on actual light sources. Follow the source's corrected advice: use a flat deep-ink or navy base rather than copying its documented blue-purple gradient demo; combine that base with only two or three contrasting saturated accents such as cyan #32BAEE/#7DD3DC, orange-yellow #F48301/#E07919/#FACC12, magenta #BE3A95/#C83C7F and light #E7DFE1/#F9FCFB. Do not mix an older pale low-saturation palette with a modern dark palette within one scene. Layer scenery in depth, with foreground silhouettes and softly moving environmental stars, particles or clouds. Trigger at least one meaningful state change per narration sentence, with soft strong easing, staggered related elements and restrained pop overshoot. Keep settled subjects and labels still. Before logarithmic scale travel, highlight the target and hold it at least 0.3 seconds; pass through it or pull back to reveal a larger world, preserving spatial continuity. Avoid a generic glowing orange planet for every topic, idle subject floating, constant slow zoom, labels substituting for concrete objects or cartoon substitutes for documentary evidence.

grammars.name: 证据拼贴解说
grammars.summary: 照片和剪报铺在桌面上，镜头沿证据和标线移动。
grammars.prompt: Create an approximately 10-second web animation from this script: {script}. Deliver one self-contained HTML file with embedded CSS and JavaScript using the Vox Collage Explainer animation grammar. Build an editorial evidence collage from supplied real documents, screenshots, maps or photographs, embedding them in the single file; do not fabricate archives or quotes. Use static fibrous paper and restrained shadows, with near-black #171716, paper whites #E0DCDA/#EEEDED, map paper #E4DCCF, parchment #CFB195, line red #B65255/#b8433f, dark red #93403C and muted highlighter yellow #DACF08. Present large grayscale halftone photos with pale cut edges and translucent tape, torn yellowed clippings, serif source text and bold pale-on-dark labels. Camera travel is smooth and eased; individual marks, labels and map fills advance at 12 fps. Reveal evidence with varied cuts, zooms, pans, highlight sweeps, red connections and stamps; do not repeat slide-in/type/red-circle more than three times. Move the camera toward what must be read, using eased tracking or a brief purposeful push, then stop while annotations unfold in narration time. Draw readable text last above all objects, keep neighboring text from forming false combined statements and enact each factual event only once. No animated grain during holds, continuous camera drift, tiny photos stranded on a decorative desktop, springy document entrances everywhere or template paper-tear transitions masquerading as Vox grammar.

grammars.name: 白板手绘解说
grammars.summary: 手随着讲解写字画图，最后拉远看见整张关系图。
grammars.prompt: Create an approximately 10-second web animation from this script: {script}. Deliver one self-contained HTML file with embedded CSS and JavaScript using the RSA Animate Whiteboard animation grammar. Use the RSA Animate mode consistently: one large planned whiteboard, black marker #0A0503 on #FBFBFB, with a single orange emphasis #EB701F/#F3742D or #EF7226. Use slightly irregular roughly 6–7-pixel lines at 1080p, thinner hatched shading, clear handwritten print and picture-led visual metaphors; keep quoted narration text under half the simultaneous spoken words and avoid more than one full handwritten sentence per region. Plan the final relationship map first. A right hand and marker enter from the lower right, with the nib leading the visible stroke reveal; move the hand offscreen during long gaps. Write body text around 16 characters per second and draw small icons over 0.5–1 second, adapting density to the ten-second excerpt. Reveal strokes with eased starts/ends and short pen lifts, moving between board regions with sine-eased pans that retain spatial overlap; finish by pulling back to the whole argument and holding. Keep solid lines for occurred events, dashed lines for plans and dotted lines for cross-section links. Ink stays until erased, never fades decoratively. Do not mix hard-cut paper-page grammar, move into speech bubbles as a default transition, let the nib drift away from revealed marks, repeat identical block layouts or fill the board with transcription instead of visual reasoning. RSA narration has no music bed.

grammars.name: 简笔角色讲故事
grammars.summary: 简笔角色快切姿势后定住，用反应特写配合口播。
grammars.prompt: Create an approximately 10-second web animation from this script: {script}. Deliver one self-contained HTML file with embedded CSS and JavaScript using the Storytime Character Animation animation grammar. Treat narration as the lead performance and draw simple expressive pose-to-pose reaction images. Use rounded heads and bean-shaped bodies, blunt tubular arms, minimal hands, thick dark character contours #1B1B1F at least twice the background line weight, skin #FFE2CC, white clothing, low-saturation background blocks #DCE9EC/#E2C29B/#E8DCC8 and a darker reaction backdrop #3D405B. Keep backgrounds to three to five large shapes and preserve the supplied protagonist's identifying features rather than importing the source demo's identity. Cut poses in roughly 0.10 seconds and hold for 0.4–0.7 seconds; use only slight settling squash if needed. Align closed/half/open mouths to speech at a maximum of 12 changes per second and close the mouth during silence. Favor medium shots, hard cuts, jump-ins, a brief whip toward the object being discussed and smash cuts to large reaction faces; a sudden wide shot can convey helplessness. Put reaction shots in 0.8–1.5-second silent gaps, let punchlines hold at least 0.9 seconds and finish sound tails naturally. Characters are already in position on the first frame; props and symbols may pop in. Avoid smoothing every pose, constant idle camera push, overactive subtitles, narration through the reaction pause or cuts that interrupt a spoken phrase.

grammars.name: 动态文字排版
grammars.summary: 关键词踩着重音进入画面，字落定后保持不动。
grammars.prompt: Create an approximately 10-second web animation from this script: {script}. Deliver one self-contained HTML file with embedded CSS and JavaScript using the Kinetic Typography animation grammar. Make the words the actors: one dominant stressed keyword at a time, no more than four Chinese characters or comparably brief text, with a supporting line no longer than fourteen Chinese characters. Use a main/support/label size hierarchy near 3.4:1:0.4, heavy sans serif, generous margins and chapter-colored flat backgrounds: yellow #FFD23F, coral #FF5A36, navy #14213D or cream #F4EFE6, with ink #111111 and white; use only one active accent, with blue #3A86FF or green #2BB673 when semantically needed. Use circles, clipped highlighter bands, simple cards and a low-opacity dot grid. Slam main words from about 1.7x scale with a small overshoot that settles around 0.35 seconds, raise supporting text through a baseline mask, pop symbols and slide evidence cards. Tie every event to a spoken stress or a beat grid such as the source's 120 BPM; align the new scene's actual reveal, not the transition's start, to the strong beat. Words stay fixed after landing; movement comes from short beat punches, background dots and transitions. Exit faster than entering, vary layouts within three pages, preserve readable holds and end with a clear final beat and pause. No outlined/shadowed lettering, equal-size text walls, simultaneously entering everything or continuously drifting words.

grammars.name: 卡通讲解员科普

grammars.prompt: Create an approximately 10-second web animation from this script: {script}. Deliver one self-contained HTML file with embedded CSS and JavaScript using the Presenter Explainer animation grammar. Use the source's presenter-led explainer grammar with a cartoon presenter moving between paper, charts and keywords. Required source material is user-supplied character frames and voiceover; this card supplies neither and must not be treated as a ready-made film. Embed the supplied full-body and bust frames and audio in the single HTML file; use actual supplied sitting or leaning poses where those actions are required rather than stretching an unrelated frame. The source does not prescribe a fixed palette or surface treatment beyond the paper/chart context, so follow the supplied character and material colors consistently. Vary side-on presentation, full-screen numbers, side-by-side comparison, the presenter entering the diagram and reaction close-ups instead of keeping a person-left/chart-right layout throughout. Normalize pose heights, anchor full-body figures at their feet and change poses with hard cuts and a slight pop, never contour dissolves that produce double images. Synchronize speaking/closed-mouth frames with voiceover, stop mouth motion in pauses and use a complete walk cycle for walking. Numbers settle when spoken; do not display 'more than' or '+' before the counter reaches the claimed value, and reveal emphasis rings afterward. Reserve pauses after highlights, share one clock across years, captions and headings, reset each scene's character position/scale explicitly, preserve outer fade opacity in nested drawing and use scene-camera movement rather than enlarging full-frame bitmaps. Keep people from covering text or being cropped during pushes.

Use local gestures, head movement and silhouette motion to carry the script. Keep medium-frequency rock relief subtle: strong relief looks like camouflage. Do not multiply the pigment layer, which erases chalk, or use additive firelight that washes ochres pink-white; do not replace local action with full-screen flashing.

Render Attic black-figure pottery with warm terracotta #dc6a2f/#e8803f, black glaze silhouettes #1b120d, fine incised orange lines #e8904c, added purple-red bands #8a2a37 and white dots #f6ead6; secondary ochres are #f2bd48, #f2913f and cream #f3cfa4. Build a Pompeian stone mosaic with tesserae aligned along contours, irregular cut edges, close-packed mortar gaps about 1.5–2.5 px at 1080p, and upper-left bevel lighting. Keep the main stone layout fixed while moving narrative colors through it; for legible moving borders use seamless clockwise tessera conveyor strips with static corner blocks, following the source's final revision. Animate drifting smoke, sparks, rippling wave borders and clear figure gestures. Use finer stones for faces and independent tiny-tessera inlays for small moving props, with thick monoline lettering about two stones wide. Avoid sparse mortar-dominated layouts, detail patches with different wall tile sizes, half-updated stones at animation bounds, and fine serif strokes that disappear. styles.name: 哥特泥金手抄本

Make a Gothic illuminated manuscript on parchment, with gold leaf ranging #9c6a1a through #d9a63a to #f8de86, red robes, blue cloaks, cream faces and jewel-like stained glass. Give gold fine horizontal burnishing, engraved diamond embossing, bright offset cuts and faint square leaf seams. Use pointed arches, slender pinnacles, dense ivy ornament and blackletter with red initials; keep faces and poses medieval rather than modern naturalistic. Sweep a diagonal highlight at constant speed only across gold, with small four-point stars appearing as it passes. Animate dense vine and leaf sways, stained-glass glints, a crawling snail, scampering or pendulum-like marginal creatures and localized character gestures with fine ink steam. Preserve clear material separation: mask gold by its color so parchment and pink areas do not glitter. Avoid an eased sweep that leaves the gold before the important gesture, sparse miniature foliage, modern handled mugs where a period chalice is appropriate, and overlapping costume/halo layers in the wrong order.

styles.name: 文艺复兴晕涂

Add subtle canvas weave, random low-opacity oil strokes and fine craquelure with a faint raised light edge. Keep faces readable with a lightly softened layer plus a predominantly clear layer, following the final revision. Animate river glints, birds or a ribbed bat-wing ornithopter as script-appropriate motifs, softly blurred window-light wedges, drifting dust, cloud-shadow changes and restrained hair, head and hand gestures. Avoid swirling high-contrast impasto that reads as Van Gogh, sharp polygonal light beams, bright graphic floor tiles, heavy inner shadows that make pale forms glassy, or a blurred protagonist against a sharper background.

styles.name: 印象派

styles.prompt: Create an approximately 10-second web animation from this script: {script}. Deliver one self-contained HTML file with embedded CSS and JavaScript, expressing the script in the Impressionism style. Use bright Impressionist broken color with pale ground #f2e6ee, pink-lilac walls #d8bede/#f0c8cc/#f2c4d4, warm cream sunlight, rose-orange-purple floors, blue-violet whites and garden greens punctuated by poppy red. Preserve white structural frames and saturated flower accents. Figures carry fine internal strokes and only delicate violet facial marks, never heavy outlines. Following the source's final revision, keep brush positions and per-cell random seeds fixed, including during masks and palette changes. Movement comes from drifting and irregularly flickering light patches, wind-bent flowers, moving clouds, billowing curtains, foliage, ribbons and local head/tail gestures. Do not regenerate the entire brush field at 8 fps, let coarse strokes erase small objects, recolor white frames into walls, or leave dark default contour strokes on faces.

Use Van Gogh-like directional impasto with dark-blue drawn structure and region-specific palettes: walls #7f9be6/#5f7fd8/#a7bbf2/#6c6fd2/#8ad0e6/#c3cbf6/#4f6cc8/#9a8fe0, sky #22339a/#2f4fb8/#5c86dc/#8fb6ee/#1b2a78/#3c6bd0 and floor #c0573c/#a8453a/#d7774a/#8e3b30/#5f8f6a/#c96a52/#e08a5c. Render props and figures on separate layers with finer internal strokes, then restore lines and facial details. Animate 8-fps line/stroke boiling, rotating sky vortices, expanding dashed lamp halos, star flicker, curling steam and spiral markings rotating slowly on suitable subjects. Never use one brush scale over the whole frame, break small props with coarse strokes, or substitute brightness jitter within one blue for the source's varied regional hues.

Create a Mucha-style Art Nouveau lithographic poster with gray-green to peach ground #b9cba0/#cfd3a6/#ecc9a2, dark-brown lines #4e3320, gold #c9a24a/#9c7a2e, cream #f6eedb, pink #e6aaa5/#d48e8c, poppy coral #d9706a/#b4504b and wrought-iron green #3d7763. Hair starts as one mass with narrow individual curls, not thick sausage-like strips.
